name: Scoops
description: A man in his mid sixties, a cheerful Italian-American ice-cream-cart vendor who sings doo-wop, warm and theatrical.
build: A short, round, sturdy build: a big round belly, broad soft shoulders, thick arms and short legs, standing upright on straight knees.
face: Olive skin with ruddy cheeks, warm brown eyes under thick grey brows, a big rounded nose, a thick white handlebar moustache and full lips.
hair: Short white hair at the sides below the hat.
outfit: A tall white folded paper soda-jerk hat; a short-sleeved white shirt; a long apron from chest to knee in wide bold vertical stripes of pink and white; a mint-green bow tie; brown trousers; brown shoes.
performance_style: Warm and upright: feet planted hip-width, belly forward. The character-right and character-left hands open and empty, spread at waist height palms up in welcome, fingers visible. Head level, a cheery open look.
location: A sunny boardwalk of weathered planks running to the bottom of the frame, a white ice-cream cart with a striped umbrella behind at one side, the railing and a bright beach and sea beyond.
avoid: an ice-cream scoop or cone in hand

sing.intent: Doo-wop vocal loop: the mic in the character-right hand at the mouth, the character-left hand sweeps open to the side on the high note, a gentle sway, then back to the welcoming stance. The mouth must visibly open and change shape across the loop so the character unmistakably reads as singing.

animations.flinch: A car horn from the road: he jumps, hands to the chest, then chuckles and settles. No opponent or contact.
animations.guard: One-shot: turns a shoulder forward and raises both open palms at chest height; hold. Not combat.
animations.entrance: One-shot: strolls in with a jaunty waddle, tips the paper hat, spreads both hands in welcome.
animations.victory: One-shot: kisses the fingertips of the character-right hand and flings it wide, then both arms wide, head back laughing, holds.
animations.ko: Non-contact defeat: the belly sags, both open hands hang, the moustache droops with the head bowed. Stays standing on both planted feet in every frame — no kneeling, crouching, sitting, sinking or going to the ground. No impact, injury or opponent.
